terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: FastAPI backend API on http://localhost:8000 (interactive docs at /docs when DEBUG=true). Serves chat, schemes, eligibility, voice and health endpoints under /api/v1.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Next.js dev server (Turbopack) on http://localhost:3000. Talks to the backend at http://localhost:8000/api/v1.
